extraction.title: Bartleby
extraction.subtitle: AI and the danger of cognitive surrender How much should managers let bots do the thinking?
extraction.summary: The article discusses the cognitive effects of AI on decision-making and critical thinking in the workplace. It highlights the risks of 'cognitive surrender' where reliance on AI diminishes personal problem-solving skills. Managers are encouraged to foster critical thinking among employees to mitigate these risks.
